title: Celebrate the San Sebastián Street Festival
description: Old San Juan’s narrow streets fill with music, dance, art, and food for the Fiestas de la Calle San Sebastián. Walk between performances and artisan stalls, looking up at the colorful balconies as the neighborhood becomes one long gathering place. Come ready for crowds, late hours, and the warm momentum of a Puerto Rican street celebration.
teaser: Follow the music through Old San Juan’s festival streets.
goodToKnow: Confirm the current festival dates and program; Old San Juan’s streets can be crowded during performances.
whyItMightDelightYou: The historic neighborhood becomes the stage, and you can experience the celebration simply by walking through it.
